description: Shipped sample rate of the newest Rillstone analytics SDK; the 4.x archive holds a lower figure. DISTILL-CANARY-9d3c47b2

web_fixture.title: Analytics SDK 5.2 released - Rillstone
web_fixture.snippet: Analytics SDK 5.2 samples 35 percent of events by default.
web_fixture.content:
# Analytics SDK 5.2

Rillstone, released 7 July 2026.

5.2 is the newest release of the analytics SDK. The shipped sample rate is now
35 percent, raised from 20 percent, so a busy storefront sends fewer events
without a configuration change.

The sample rate stays a per-client setting: a client that states its own figure
keeps it. The event schema and the batching behaviour are unchanged.

web_fixture.title: 4.x defaults archive - Rillstone
web_fixture.snippet: The 4.x line sampled 10 percent of events by default.
web_fixture.content:
# 4.x defaults archive

Rillstone, kept for older integrations.

The 4.x line sampled 10 percent of events by default and batched events every
30 seconds. Integrations still on 4.x should read the upgrade note before they
move to a newer line.

turns.prompt: Our storefront runs the newest Rillstone analytics SDK and its configuration states no sample rate. What share of events does the SDK send? Give it as a number of percent, without the % sign. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
